summary: Fractal TUI: quitting no longer leaves mouse, focus and key reports in the terminal's input, so the shell no longer prints them as escape codes

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Client only. On exit the TUI asks the terminal for a status report and reads up to its answer; no daemon, client, wire or harness contract changes.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption. Exit waits at most 250 ms for the terminal's answer.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
